option_A.name: HTTP 直接沿用既有 CSV_V1
option_A.before_paragraph: Dataset import is multipart metadata(application/json) + file(text/csv), UTF-8 without BOM, RFC4180 header exactly `instrument_id,contract_id,timeframe,bar_open_utc,open,high,low,close,volume`. Timestamp is UTC Z, prices canonical decimals, volume nonnegative integer; high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), high >= low. Caller supplies trusted reference revisions, not executable mappings. BFF/Python stream into staging with a 256 MiB file cap and independently verified SHA256; filename is ignored. One MiB ordinary JSON limit applies to metadata/other mutations, not the streamed file. No remote URL fetch or filesystem path import. Admission creates durable import operation only after complete verified upload; crash before acceptance leaves unreferenced staging file, cleaned after 7 days. Exact retry compares metadata + file hash; file byte differences with same key reject. Successful import atomically publishes qualified DatasetVersion/manifest; cancellation before publish retains no visible dataset. Parent/correction reason must both be present or both absent; a correction must reference the same dataset. CSV cannot directly establish canonical operational observation acceptance; the accepted adapter still validates reference/identity/provenance.
option_A.after_paragraph: Dataset import is multipart metadata(application/json) + file(text/csv), with ImportMetadata.format = CSV_V1. The uploaded file follows the CSV_V1 contract in V1_DATASET_IDENTITY_IO.md: strict UTF-8, at most one BOM at the very beginning, RFC4180 comma/double-quote syntax and LF or CRLF; reject NUL, duplicate headers, extra/missing columns and empty data rows. Header order is exactly `source_code,bar_open_utc,open,high,low,close,volume,amount,trade_count,tick_count`. source_code is a nonempty opaque mapping key without surrounding whitespace; metadata source_name binds the pinned mapping namespace. Resolve instrument_id/contract_id through that exact mapping snapshot; do not accept direct identity columns, guess mappings or use mutable latest references. Timestamps are real Gregorian whole minutes `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00Z`, without local-time guessing. OHLC and nonempty amount follow the existing Decimal wire lexical; exponent/NaN/Infinity/float are forbidden. volume is a required nonnegative integer; empty amount/trade_count/tick_count means null and nonempty counts are nonnegative integers. high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), high >= low. trade_date/session_ref come from the pinned calendar, not CSV. Caller supplies trusted reference revisions, not executable mappings. BFF/Python stream into staging with a 256 MiB file cap and independently verified SHA256; filename is ignored. One MiB ordinary JSON limit applies to metadata/other mutations, not the streamed file. No remote URL fetch or filesystem path import. Admission creates durable import operation only after complete verified upload; crash before acceptance leaves unreferenced staging file, cleaned after 7 days. Exact retry compares metadata + file hash; file byte differences with same key reject. Successful import atomically publishes qualified DatasetVersion/manifest; cancellation before publish retains no visible dataset. Parent/correction reason must both be present or both absent; a correction must reference the same dataset. CSV cannot directly establish canonical operational observation acceptance; the accepted adapter still validates reference/identity/provenance.
